Places of Amusement License

A Places of Amusemement License is needed to operate a place open to the public for purposes of entertainment either free or for a fee. This includes but not limited to the following: Open Air Dance, Party, Night Club, Theatre, Festival, Sporting Event, any place where a coin amusement machine is operated or any other activity deemed entertainment

Types of Places of Amusement License

1. Annual Licence - The annual licence is appropriate for businesses that offer entertainment to the public as part of their routine daily operations. This is granted from the 1st of April of on year to the 31st of March of the following year. Applications for an annual licence should be done no later than March 1st of each year. Failure to do so will attract a penalty charge.

2. Special Event - This type of Amusement Licence is granted to persons or businesses hosting special entertainment events through out the year at locations within the municipality. Application deadline should be at least ten (10) working days before the date of the event for events that are expected to have less than 1000 patrons. Amusement Licence application should be received no later than twenty one (21)working days before the date of the event. Failure to comply will result in a penalty charge.

Approval/Refusal/Revocation of Licence

Completed application for annual licences will be processed and forwarded to the Building and Town Planning Committee of the Municipal Corporation for its decision. Applications for annual licences will be processed within 21 days of receipt unless there are issues raised by other agencies such as Health, JCF, NWA and Fire Department that require further investigation or clarification. With regards to Special events licences, approval or refusal will be communicated to applicant within 5 to 10 working days of receipt of the application. Application should also be made to JCF for Noise Abatement Permit which will be needed by Municipal Corporation for approving permit.

The Municipal Corporation may revoke a licence if it is determined that the

  • Applicant or Licencee has been convicted of a criminal offence
  • Applicant has failed to comply with any of the prescribed conditions of approval
  • Applicant fail to declare accurately the structures and advertising displays

Penalty for Non-Compliance

  • Closure of Venue/Event
  • Demand for payment for undeclared structures and displays with penalty charges
  • Prosecution

Select Your Municipality

Your application will be routed to the municipal corporation responsible for the parish where the event or venue is located.

Please select a parish to continue.

How your information is shared

A Places of Amusement Licence involves more than one government agency. By applying, you consent to your application information — including identification, contact details, and event or venue details — being shared between the Municipal Corporation responsible for your parish, the Jamaica Constabulary Force, and other regulatory or enforcement agencies, strictly as required by law to assess, approve, and enforce this application.

    JCF Integration

    Auto-reject application if JCF rejects the linked JCF application

    When on, if the Jamaica Constabulary Force rejects an applicant's JCF Noise Abatement Permit application, the linked Places of Amusement application here is automatically marked Rejected as well.

    Municipal Fee Payment Timing

    Allow applicants to pay the Municipal portion (License Fee onward) after JCF approval

    When on, applicants may wait until their JCF Noise Abatement Permit is approved before paying the License Fee and any additional fees. When off, applicants are advised to pay the License Fee immediately after the Application Fee (paid to Atendify).

    Customize the business types and event types shown on your municipality's application form, and which documents are required for each. Only the CEO can change these.

    Venue Inspection Fee

    Charged to an applicant who manually types in a venue not yet in your registered venues database — covers the initial inspection visit. This is a separate charge from any Venue Cost assessed later if the venue is accepted into your database (see Venues > Venues Pending Review) — both are billed in full. Only the CEO can change this.

    Revenue — Municipal Corporations

    Each application's fee splits into two payees: the municipality's own venue-inspection and advertisement charges (shown here) and Atendify's application fee (shown separately below). Refunds/Waivers/Discounts are recorded once per application, not split between the two — see the hint on the Atendify panel.

    Municipality / AgencyBilledCollectedOutstanding

    Application Fee — collected by Atendify

    This is the fee Atendify itself charges per application — it isn't part of the municipality's own revenue above. A waiver an admin records against an application reduces the municipality's share only; it does not reduce what's owed here, since a municipality can't unilaterally waive Atendify's own fee.

    National venue registry

    Pulled live from every municipality's own venue database — the same registered-venue records applicants pick from during submission.     Loading…

    Set a target turnaround time for each stage of this division's review pipeline. Only the Police Chief can change these.

    Review Turnaround (SLA)

    Toggle a stage off to stop tracking it; when on, an application that misses its target shows up under Manage → SLA Breaches.

    Supervisor — assign an officer
    Officer/Supervisor — complete checklist & recommend
    Police Chief — approve or reject

    Municipal Integration

    Auto-reject application if the Municipal Corporation rejects the linked Places of Amusement application

    When on, if the Municipal Corporation rejects the linked Places of Amusement application, this JCF Noise Abatement Permit application is automatically marked Rejected as well.

    SLA Breaches

    Open applications (not yet Approved or Rejected) that have missed one of the review-pipeline stage targets — set under Settings → SLA Policy. An application can appear more than once if it has missed more than one stage.

    Licensing Year Archive

    When a new licensing year begins, archive every application currently on file as a permanent, dated snapshot. Archiving doesn't delete or hide anything from your active Applications list — it just keeps a copy of exactly where things stood for that year.
